API.validate_derivation: (*,host,derivation,tick,limits=None), unchanged body; new module VERSION reported

fragment_priority.LARGEST_REPEATED_FIRST: Same original catalogue admission/traversal, repeated-occurrence predicate and (-node_count, complete scoped key) order. Additive post-build reporting costs apply in both modes; no historical work-prefix equivalence.

OPEN_INPUT_OUTPUT_FIRST.admission: Same bounded catalogue keys, no extra fragment admission. Independently traverse explicit-open source-DAG input and exposed-output formula trees and update only already catalogued keys, descending below untracked ancestors even at capacity.
OPEN_INPUT_OUTPUT_FIRST.eligibility: Old repeated occurrence count >=2 OR tracked key actually probed at both an explicit-open source input and exposed output.
lexicographic_rank: within coupled entries, FORMULA equal to whole exposed output first
OPEN_INPUT_OUTPUT_FIRST.open_input_evidence: Only a cut boundary whose original_reference is an actual source-DAG input and whose supplied occupied field is literal false. A cut-out node or conditional input alone is insufficient. This is supplied structural evidence, not fresh physical/native authority.
OPEN_INPUT_OUTPUT_FIRST.scope: No alpha-equating or free/bound-name conflation; FORMULA and TERM remain distinct. Root input and output probes start in empty lexical scope; all-binders extend native-name scope.

fragment_priority.invalid: Exact str enum or MiningDataError(code=FRAGMENT_PRIORITY); callback/native errors never converted to own UNKNOWN.

native_obligations: Fresh f32e all-port expansion + independent4358 full check + native4bd6 membership/point-union admission remain mandatory per actual grounding; no learned restriction, pruning, degree/EOF or search authority.
outcomes: Inherited PROPOSALS if any complete retained records, otherwise UNKNOWN. mining_complete always false. Own finite work/depth gives only bounded proposal prefix; all broad FLAGS remain exact V2 false/proposal-only values.

post_build_metadata.coupled_parameters: Only actual built FORMULA/TERM parameter IDs occurring in input templates and exposed output templates, with full ordered abstraction locations and separate explicit-open subset. Never use pre-build rank as proof of coupling.
post_build_metadata.nulls: source_DAG_input_occupied=null for cut-out-node inputs; selected_fragment_coupled_after_build=null for literal variant, even when conservative literal-shadow abstractions exist.
post_build_metadata.physical_caveat: physical_occupancy_verified=false in every input evidence entry. Actual root/current occupancy must be independently rebound later.
post_build_metadata.shadowing_caveat: LITERAL_BINDER_SHADOWING may abstract an enclosing expression and hide selected descendants. No promise of post-build coupling, full environment inference, useful transfer or theorem validity.

retention.caps: All DEFAULT_LIMITS exact V2; advisory same generalizations_per_cut slice, immediate family cap and round-robin cuts preserved. No extra build-and-rerank/rescue work.
retention.full_preimage_dedup: Same ID requires same full descriptor family_preimage; no hash-injectivity assumption.
retention.wire: Existing RESULT/EXTRACTION/descriptor schemas and record top-level fields unchanged. reason adds fragment_priority. New costs.interface_coupling metadata; optional newmode fragment_generalization.interface_probe.
